name: Panic Disorder Severity Scale — Self-Report (PDSS-SR)
directions: Self-report about the past week. Rate each area from 0 to 4 using the descriptions. The source form defines the composite as the mean of seven items; raw total is also shown for transparency.

questions.text: Panic attacks and limited-symptom attacks during the past week
questions.definition: 0 none; 1 mild, no full attack and no more than one limited attack/day; 2 moderate, 1–2 full attacks and/or multiple limited attacks/day; 3 severe, more than 2 full attacks but no more than 1/day on average; 4 extreme, full attacks more than once a day on most days.

questions.text: Distress during panic or limited-symptom attacks
questions.definition: 0 none; 1 mild; 2 moderate but manageable; 3 severe; 4 extreme distress during all attacks.

questions.text: Anticipatory anxiety about future attacks or their consequences
questions.definition: 0 not at all; 1 occasionally/mildly; 2 frequently/moderately; 3 very often or disturbing; 4 nearly constantly and disabling.

questions.text: Fear or avoidance of situations because of panic attacks
questions.definition: 0 none; 1 mild, little lifestyle change; 2 moderate, some avoidance but manageable; 3 severe, extensive avoidance and lifestyle change; 4 pervasive, disabling avoidance.

questions.text: Fear or avoidance of activities that cause panic-like physical sensations
questions.definition: 0 none; 1 mild, little lifestyle change; 2 moderate, limited change; 3 severe, substantial interference; 4 pervasive, disabling avoidance.

questions.text: Interference with work or home responsibilities
questions.definition: 0 none; 1 slight; 2 significant but manageable; 3 substantial impairment; 4 incapacitating.
0 none; 1 slight; 2 significant but manageable; 3 substantial impairment; 4 incapacitating.
